title: Fix evaluator precedence, associativity, and error handling to match its spec
prompt: evaluator.py is an arithmetic expression evaluator whose module docstring is the agreed contract, but the implementation gets several of the documented semantics wrong and tests in test_evaluator.py fail. Fix evaluator.py so it fully satisfies the spec: operator precedence (including where unary minus sits relative to ^), right-associativity of ^, true division, int/float result types, and ValueError (never any other exception) on all malformed input including trailing tokens. Keep the spec docstring intact. The tests encode the agreed-on spec and must not be weakened or changed. Run python3 -m pytest to check your work.

checks.needle: this docstring is the agreed contract
